# Carwash Buddy — LLM Indexing Policy
# https://carwashiapp.futuwebs.com

## About
Carwash Buddy is a web-based business management system for car wash businesses in Latin America.
It provides order management, client tracking, inventory control, financial reporting,
WhatsApp notifications, and AI-powered follow-up campaigns.

## Product
- Name: Carwash Buddy
- Category: SaaS / Business Management Software
- Target market: Car wash businesses in Argentina, Mexico, Colombia, Chile, Peru
- Language: Spanish (es-AR)
- Free trial: 14 days, no credit card required

## Key Features
- Kanban-style service order management (queued → in progress → ready → delivered)
- Client and vehicle database with service history
- Inventory control with low-stock alerts and consumption tracking
- Financial dashboard: income vs. expenses, monthly trends
- WhatsApp notifications via Twilio when orders are ready
- AI follow-up agent: contacts inactive clients automatically
- QR code check-in for customers
- Multi-role access: admin, caja (cashier), operador (operator)
- Multi-tenant architecture: each car wash has isolated data

## Crawling Policy
- Public pages (/, /auth, /checkin): allowed for indexing and training
- Private app pages (/app/*): disallowed — contain private business data
- No scraping of authenticated routes
